The '''third moon of Concord Dawn''' was an astronomical body in the [[Concord Dawn system]], and a [[moon]] of the shattered [[Planet|world]] of [[Concord Dawn]]. The [[Journeyman Protector|Mandalorian Protectors]], a group of [[Mandalorian]] warriors sworn to protect the system, established a [[Protectors Camp|base]] on the third moon.<ref name="Protectors DB" /> After the Protectors [[Dogfight over Concord Dawn|attacked]] a [[Phoenix Cell|rebel]] mission led by [[Hera Syndulla]] in [[3 BBY]], the rebels [[Kanan Jarrus]] and [[Sabine Wren]] [[Mission to the third moon of Concord Dawn|attacked]] the Protectors' base and kidnapped their leader, [[Fenn Rau]]. Rau subsequently allowed the rebellion safe passage through the Concord Dawn system.<ref name="The Protector of Concord Dawn" />

[[2 BBY|A year later]], Rau's rival Imperial [[Viceroy]] [[Gar Saxon]] and his [[Imperial Super Commando]]s launched an attack on the Protectors Camp in an effort to lure Rau out of hiding. Saxon had learnt about the Protectors' collaboration with the rebels and slaughtered Rau's followers. Rau, Sabine, and her fellow rebels [[Ezra Bridger]] and [[C1-10P|Chopper]] [[Second mission to the third moon of Concord Dawn|returned]] to the moon to investigate. After joining forces to escape Saxon, Rau decided to join the rebellion.<ref name="ISC" />
